query: SELECT c.id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, SUM(p.currentStock * p.avgCost) as finalStock FROM products p INNER JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id WHERE p.active = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY finalStock DESC LIMIT 5
